Apple AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation — White

The Apple AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation are the most capable open-ear AirPods Apple has ever made. AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation feature a totally transformed audio experience with Adaptive Audio and Transparency mode and an updated fit for all-day comfort. This is the version of AirPods 4 that adds the features most people actually need — noise cancellation for focus, Transparency mode for awareness and Adaptive Audio to manage both automatically. For iPhone users in Pakistan who want the best possible wireless listening experience without the in-ear seal of AirPods Pro, the AirPods 4 ANC are the definitive choice.

Active Noise Cancellation — Powered by H2

AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation help reduce outside noise before it reaches your ears, powered by the H2 chip and upgraded microphones. It helps reduce low-frequency environmental noise like airplane engines and city traffic before it reaches your ears. For daily commuters in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad navigating traffic, auto-rickshaws, construction noise and crowded public spaces, ANC is one of the most practically useful features any earbuds can offer. You put them on, turn on ANC and the background noise of the city fades significantly. Your music, calls and podcasts come through clearly without needing to raise the volume.

Adaptive Audio — The Intelligent Middle Ground

Adaptive Audio seamlessly blends Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency mode to provide the best listening experience in any environment. Rather than manually switching between ANC and Transparency, Adaptive Audio reads your environment continuously and adjusts in real time. Walking into a quiet office, ANC takes over. Stepping outside into traffic, Transparency blends in so you can hear what is around you safely. Entering a coffee shop, a balance between both is applied. The result is a listening experience that adjusts to your environment without you needing to touch your phone or the earbuds. For Pakistani commuters whose environment changes constantly throughout the day, Adaptive Audio removes the friction of manually managing noise control entirely.

Transparency Mode — Hear the World Naturally

Transparency mode lets you comfortably hear and interact with the world around you exactly as it sounds — perfect for staying connected to your surroundings when on a call or listening to music or podcasts. Transparency mode on the AirPods 4 ANC uses the H2 chip to process outside audio so naturally that it sounds as if you are not wearing earbuds at all. You can hold a conversation, hear announcements in a shop or listen for traffic without removing your AirPods. For the moments when awareness matters — crossing a road, being in a meeting or talking to someone at work — Transparency mode keeps you connected to your surroundings instantly.

Conversation Awareness — No More Awkward Pauses

When you are speaking with someone nearby, Conversation Awareness automatically lowers the volume of what is playing, bringing it right back as soon as you are done. The AirPods detect that you have started speaking to someone in person and instantly reduce the audio volume without you pressing anything. When the conversation ends, your audio returns to its previous level automatically. For Pakistanis who wear their AirPods throughout the workday and regularly need to interact with colleagues, family or shopkeepers, Conversation Awareness makes social interaction with AirPods in genuinely seamless.

Personalized Spatial Audio With Dynamic Head Tracking

Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking places sound all around you, creating a theater-like listening experience for music, TV shows, movies, games, and more. Spatial Audio maps your personal ear shape using your iPhone's TrueDepth camera to create a custom audio profile. Once set up, music, films and content plays in three-dimensional space around you — sound comes from the left, right, above and below rather than from a single point between your ears. Dynamic head tracking means if you turn your head, the audio field stays fixed in space rather than rotating with you, as if the sound is coming from the screen rather than from inside your head. On YouTube, Netflix, Apple Music and any supported app this transforms ordinary listening into something significantly more immersive.

The H2 Chip — What It Actually Changes

The Apple H2 chip is the reason the AirPods 4 ANC can do everything they do at this size and this battery life. The powerful H2 chip comes to AirPods 4, making audio and calls sound better than ever. The H2 processes ANC, Transparency mode, Adaptive Audio, Spatial Audio, Conversation Awareness and Voice Isolation for calls simultaneously in real time. Without the H2's processing power, none of these features would be possible in an earbud this small. It also enables the intelligent automatic switching between your Apple devices — when you pause audio on your iPhone and start a video on your iPad, the AirPods switch automatically without any input from you.

Voice Isolation for Crystal Clear Calls

Voice Isolation on calls means clearer calls with a hands-free way to interact with Siri. Voice Isolation uses the H2 chip and the upgraded microphone array to separate your voice from background noise during calls. In a busy Pakistani market, inside a car, or on a crowded street, your voice comes through clearly to the person you are calling without them hearing the environment around you. This is a meaningful improvement over standard microphone-only noise reduction, which captures background noise and attempts to reduce it after the fact. Voice Isolation identifies your voice first and only transmits that.

Siri Interactions — Control With a Nod

With Siri Interactions, you can respond to Siri by simply nodding your head yes or shaking your head no. Just say Siri or Hey Siri to play a song, make a call, or check your schedule. Siri Interactions removes the need to speak out loud when Siri asks you a question — particularly useful when you are in a meeting, a public space or somewhere speaking out loud is inconvenient. Nod for yes, shake for no. The AirPods detect the head movement using their motion sensors and respond accordingly.

Rebuilt for Comfort — All-Day Wear Without Fatigue

AirPods 4 have been redesigned for exceptional all-day comfort and greater stability. With a refined contour, shorter stem, and quick-press controls for music or calls. The AirPods 4 are an open-ear design with no silicone ear tip that goes into the ear canal. This makes them significantly more comfortable for extended wear than in-ear designs like AirPods Pro, which can cause ear fatigue over long sessions. For Pakistani users who wear their AirPods from morning to evening — during commutes, at work, during exercise and relaxing at home — the open-ear comfort means they stay in all day without discomfort.

Battery Life and Charging

AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation deliver up to 5 hours of listening time on a single charge with noise control off, and up to 4 hours with Active Noise Cancellation enabled. With the charging case, total listening time is up to 30 hours with noise control off and up to 20 hours with ANC on. 5 minutes in the case provides around 1 hour of listening time. The 5-minute fast charge is one of the most practically useful features for everyday use. You are running late, the AirPods are dead — 5 minutes charging while you get ready and you have an hour of listening for your commute. No need to wait for a full charge to be functional.

Three Ways to Charge

The charging case works with USB-C, an Apple Watch charger, or a Qi-certified charger. The case is the smallest in the industry with wireless charging capability. For iPhone users who already have an Apple Watch charger on their nightstand, the AirPods 4 ANC case can charge on the same puck. For anyone with a Qi wireless charging pad — which is compatible with most Samsung and other wireless charging accessories — the case can be placed on it without any cable. The USB-C port provides the fastest wired charging for when you need it quickly.

IP54 Water and Sweat Resistance

AirPods 4 and the Charging Case are rated IP54 dust, sweat, and water resistant. IP54 means both the earbuds and the case can handle sweat during workouts, rain while commuting and splashes without damage. For Pakistani users who exercise outdoors in humid Karachi weather or use their AirPods during monsoon season, IP54 provides genuine peace of mind. The case itself being IP54 rated is particularly notable — most competing earbuds only rate the earbuds themselves, not the case.

Find My Integration With Case Speaker

Track down your AirPods 4 with the Find My app. See how close they are and get separation alerts if they are out of Bluetooth range. For AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation, you can have the case play a sound so you can locate it. The built-in speaker on the charging case is exclusive to the ANC model — the standard AirPods 4 case does not have it. This means you can ring the case through Find My and hear it from another room, which is meaningfully more useful than only being able to locate the earbuds themselves.

Automatic Switching Across Apple Devices

AirPods 4 pair immediately with every device connected to your Apple Account. Just place AirPods near your iPhone or iPad and tap Connect. AirPods 4 give you a seamless listening experience across iPhone, Apple Watch, Apple Vision Pro, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV. Automatic switching means your AirPods follow your attention across devices without manual input. Pause music on your iPhone, start a FaceTime call on your iPad and the AirPods switch seamlessly. For Pakistani Apple users who move between an iPhone, MacBook and iPad throughout the day, this seamless switching is one of the biggest practical advantages of AirPods over any third-party alternative.

What Is in the Box

  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation
  • Wireless Charging Case with USB-C, Apple Watch charger and Qi compatibility
  • USB-C charge cable not included

Specifications

  • Model: AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation
  • Chip: Apple H2
  • Colour: White

  • Spatial Audio: Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking
  • Microphones: Three microphones, Voice Isolation
  • Battery (AirPods): Up to 5 hours (ANC off), up to 4 hours (ANC on)
  • Battery (Total with case): Up to 30 hours (ANC off), up to 20 hours (ANC on)
  • Fast Charge: 5 minutes in case provides 1 hour of listening

  • Case Speaker: Yes, for Find My location
  • Water Resistance: IP54 (AirPods and case)

  • Sensor: Optical in-ear detection, motion-detecting accelerometer, skin-detect sensor
  • Siri: Hey Siri, Siri Interactions (nod yes, shake no)
  • Compatible: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between AirPods 4 and AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation?

The standard AirPods 4 and the AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation share the same H2 chip, design and Spatial Audio features. The ANC version adds Active Noise Cancellation, Transparency Mode, Adaptive Audio and Conversation Awareness. It also adds a wireless charging case with a built-in speaker for Find My, while the standard model's case only supports USB-C charging. If noise cancellation and Transparency mode are features you will actually use, the ANC version is worth the premium.

Does the AirPods 4 ANC work with Android phones?

AirPods 4 work as Bluetooth earbuds with any Android device. However, most of the intelligent features — Active Noise Cancellation controls, Adaptive Audio, Spatial Audio, Conversation Awareness, Siri Interactions, automatic switching and Find My — require an iPhone running iOS 18 or later. If you primarily use an Android phone, you will get basic audio functionality but miss the majority of what makes AirPods 4 ANC special. For Android users, other earbuds would be a better fit.

How effective is the Active Noise Cancellation on AirPods 4?

AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation help reduce low-frequency environmental noise like airplane engines and city traffic before it reaches your ears, powered by the H2 chip and upgraded microphones. The ANC on AirPods 4 is effective on consistent low-to-mid frequency background noise. For Karachi's traffic, air conditioning hum, office background noise and fan sounds, the ANC makes a noticeable difference. It is not as strong as the ANC on AirPods Pro 2, which uses an in-ear seal to physically block sound as well as electronically cancel it. For the most demanding noise environments, AirPods Pro 2 is the stronger option.

What is Adaptive Audio and how does it work?

Adaptive Audio seamlessly blends Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency mode in real time, tailoring noise control to your changing environment as you go about your day. You do not need to manually switch between ANC and Transparency. The H2 chip constantly analyses your environment through the microphones and applies the appropriate level of noise cancellation or ambient sound passthrough automatically. Walk from a quiet room into a busy street and Adaptive Audio responds without any input from you.

How do I charge the AirPods 4 ANC case wirelessly?

The charging case works with USB-C, an Apple Watch charger, or a Qi-certified charger. The case is the smallest in the industry with wireless charging. For Qi wireless charging, place the case flat on any Qi-compatible wireless charging pad — the same type used by Samsung phones and other Android devices — and it charges without any cable. For Apple Watch charger wireless charging, place it on the magnetic puck. Qi wireless chargers are widely available in Pakistan from electronics retailers.

Are the AirPods 4 ANC comfortable for long hours of wear?

AirPods 4 have been redesigned with a refined contour, shorter stem, and quick-press controls for exceptional all-day comfort and greater stability. The open-ear design with no silicone ear tip going into the ear canal makes extended wear significantly more comfortable than in-ear designs. Most users report wearing them comfortably for 4 to 6 hours continuously. The trade-off compared to AirPods Pro is that the open-ear design allows more ambient sound through by nature, which is why the H2-powered ANC is important to compensate.

What is the IP54 rating and does it cover rain?

AirPods 4 and the Charging Case are rated IP54 dust, sweat, and water resistant. IP54 means the earbuds and case are protected against dust and water splashing from any direction. This covers sweat during workouts, rain during a commute and water splashes. It does not mean they can be submerged. For use during Pakistan's monsoon season or during outdoor exercise in humid conditions, IP54 provides solid everyday protection for both the earbuds and the case.

Can I use AirPods 4 ANC with my MacBook?

Yes. AirPods 4 give you a seamless listening experience across iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV. They pair immediately with every device connected to your Apple Account. All your Apple devices share the same AirPods connection through your Apple Account. When you start audio on your MacBook, the AirPods switch automatically. Voice Isolation works during MacBook calls and video conferences, which is useful for working from home in Pakistan where background household noise is a common challenge during calls.

What is Siri Interactions and how does it work?

With Siri Interactions, you can respond to Siri by simply nodding your head yes or shaking your head no when Siri asks if you would like to hear a message, answer a call, or manage a notification. The AirPods use their motion sensors to detect a definitive head nod or shake and interpret it as a yes or no response to Siri. This means you can accept a call, dismiss a notification or respond to a Siri question without speaking out loud or touching your phone — particularly useful in social situations where speaking to your phone would be inconvenient.

Apple AirPods 4 — White

The Apple AirPods 4 are the most capable, most comfortable and most intelligently designed standard AirPods Apple has ever made. Launched in September 2024 alongside the iPhone 16 series, the AirPods 4 represent a complete redesign of Apple's core wireless earbud — powered by the same H2 chip found in the AirPods Pro 2, with an entirely new fit system built from over 50 million ear data points, a smaller USB-C case and a feature set that was previously reserved for the Pro models. If you want AirPods that work beautifully with your iPhone every single day without the step up to the ANC model or AirPods Pro, the standard AirPods 4 are the answer.

Built Around Your Ear — Not the Other Way Around

Apple scanned and mapped thousands of ear shapes and used over 50 million data points with 3D photogrammetry and laser topography to create a single shape that naturally fits most users. Apple says the refined contour offers a natural and secure fit for more people than ever. This matters because AirPods 4 are an open-ear design — there is no silicone tip going into the ear canal. The fit relies entirely on the geometry of the earbud body resting naturally in the ear. Getting this shape right across the widest possible range of ear shapes is what the 50 million data points went toward. The result is an earbud that stays securely in place during workouts, commutes and daily movement without causing the ear canal pressure fatigue that in-ear designs can produce over hours of wear.

The H2 Chip — Pro Performance in Standard AirPods

Apple used the same H2 chip that is in the AirPods Pro 2 for the AirPods 4. It enables features like Voice Isolation for clearer call quality and Siri Interactions so you can shake your head no or nod your head yes to respond to Siri announcements. The H2 chip is what makes the AirPods 4 significantly more capable than any previous standard AirPods. Features that required the Pro model in previous generations — Adaptive EQ, Voice Isolation, Siri Interactions and Personalized Spatial Audio — are now available in the standard AirPods 4. The H2 chip also handles automatic device switching, pairing speed improvements and audio processing quality improvements across all listening scenarios.

Key Features

Personalized Spatial Audio With Dynamic Head Tracking

Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking places sound all around you, creating a theater-like listening experience for music, TV shows, movies, games and more. Using your iPhone's TrueDepth camera, the system photographs your ear shape and builds a custom audio profile matched to your anatomy. This personalised profile places sound in three-dimensional space around you — music, films and content come from specific directions rather than a fixed point between your ears. When you turn your head, the audio field stays fixed in space, as if sound is coming from the screen rather than from the earbuds themselves. On YouTube, Netflix, Apple TV and Apple Music this creates a genuinely more immersive experience than standard stereo.

Adaptive EQ — Music That Adjusts to Your Ear

Adaptive EQ continuously tunes the audio output in real time based on how the AirPods fit in your ears. Every ear interacts with sound slightly differently due to the unique geometry of each individual's ear canal opening. Adaptive EQ measures how music sounds at your ear and adjusts the frequency balance automatically so that bass, midrange and treble all arrive in correct proportion regardless of slight variations in how the earbuds sit. You always hear music as it was intended to sound without manually adjusting any EQ settings.

Voice Isolation for Clearer Calls

Voice Isolation for clearer call quality uses the H2 chip and upgraded microphones to separate your voice from background noise during calls. Rather than simply reducing background noise after capturing everything, Voice Isolation identifies your voice first and only transmits that. On calls from a busy Pakistani street, inside a car with traffic noise or in a crowded office, the person you are calling hears your voice clearly without hearing the environment around you. This is a meaningful upgrade from standard microphone noise reduction and makes the AirPods 4 significantly more capable for calls than any previous standard AirPods generation.

Siri Interactions — Nod Yes, Shake No

With Siri Interactions, you can shake your head no or nod your head yes to respond to Siri announcements. When Siri asks if you want to hear a message, answer a call or manage a notification, you respond physically rather than speaking. The motion sensors in the AirPods detect a definitive nod or shake and interpret it as your answer. This is particularly useful in social situations, meetings or public places where speaking out loud to your earbuds would be awkward. Just nod to accept a call and shake your head to decline it, entirely hands-free.

Automatic Device Switching Across Your Apple Ecosystem

AirPods 4 pair immediately with every device connected to your Apple Account. AirPods 4 give you a seamless listening experience across iPhone, Apple Watch, Apple Vision Pro, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. Your AirPods follow your active device automatically. Start listening to music on your iPhone, begin a video on your iPad and the AirPods switch without any manual input. For Pakistani Apple users moving between a phone, laptop and tablet throughout the day, this seamless switching is one of the most practically useful features in the entire AirPods experience and is not available at this level in any third-party earbuds.

In-Ear Detection — Pauses When You Take Them Out

An optical in-ear sensor knows to play audio only when you are wearing AirPods and pauses when you take them off. Remove one AirPod from your ear during a conversation and your music, podcast or video pauses automatically. Put it back in and it resumes instantly. You never lose your place in whatever you were listening to and you never have to reach for your phone to pause. This applies to both earbuds individually — pulling one out pauses, pulling both out pauses and putting either back in resumes.

Faster Pairing and Force Sensor Controls

The stem is equipped with a force sensor that can be used to play or pause media and mute or end calls with a press, plus previous controls for skipping songs and activating Siri are available. The force sensor on the stem responds to a precise pinch — it does not accidentally trigger from brushing the stem when adjusting the earbuds. One press for play and pause, double press for skip forward, triple press for skip back and press-and-hold for Siri. All the controls you need without ever touching your phone.

Low-Latency Audio for Gaming

The AirPods 4 are also ideal for gaming, providing low wireless audio latency and good voice quality when chatting with other players. Low latency means the audio you hear matches what is happening on screen without a noticeable delay — important for mobile games where audio cues directly affect gameplay. Combined with Voice Isolation on in-game voice chat, the AirPods 4 work well as a gaming headset on iPhone for the growing mobile gaming community in Pakistan.

Battery Life and USB-C Charging

The AirPods 4 and AirPods 4 ANC case add up to a total of 30 hours of battery life without ANC. The AirPods themselves offer up to five hours of battery life on a single charge. Five minutes in the charging case provides around one hour of listening time. The fast charge capability means a 5-minute charge while you get ready in the morning gives you a full hour for your commute. The standard AirPods 4 case charges via USB-C only. Unlike the ANC version which adds wireless charging, the standard case uses a cable connection. For most users who charge overnight at their bedside, this is a non-issue.

IP54 Water and Sweat Resistance

AirPods 4 and the Charging Case are rated IP54 dust, sweat and water resistant. Both the earbuds and the case are IP54 rated, covering workouts, rain and everyday splashes. This rating on both the earbuds and case is genuinely useful for Pakistani users who exercise, commute in rain during monsoon season or simply use their AirPods throughout an active day. Sweat from exercise will not damage them and being caught in light rain will not either.

Smaller USB-C Case

The streamlined charging case is more than 10 percent smaller by volume than the previous generation, with no sacrifice to charging times. The standard AirPods 4 case charges via USB-C. It is noticeably more compact and pocketable than the AirPods 3 case — easier to carry in a pocket, easier to slip into a bag and less bulky overall. The USB-C port means you can share a charging cable with your iPhone 15 or later, MacBook, iPad or most other modern devices — one cable less to carry.

Standard AirPods 4 vs AirPods 4 with ANC — Which Should You Buy

The standard AirPods 4 is the right choice if you primarily want great sounding wireless earbuds with the full Apple ecosystem experience, excellent call quality and Spatial Audio at a more accessible price point. The case only supports USB-C charging and the earbuds do not have Active Noise Cancellation, Transparency mode or Adaptive Audio.

The AirPods 4 with ANC is the right choice if you commute daily through noisy environments, frequently need to focus in busy spaces, or want the option to switch between noise cancellation and Transparency mode. The ANC case also adds wireless charging and a built-in speaker for locating the case with Find My.

Both models sound very similar across most of the frequency range. The non-ANC version rolls off the bass frequencies below 140Hz, meaning it will not sound as heavy or deliver the same low-frequency rumble as the ANC version. For most music genres this difference is subtle. For bass-heavy music like electronic, hip-hop and the kind of desi beats popular in Pakistan, the ANC version's fuller bass is noticeable in a direct comparison.

What Is in the Box

  • AirPods 4 earbuds
  • Charging Case with USB-C port
  • USB-C charge cable not included

Specifications

  • Model: AirPods 4 (standard, without ANC)
  • Chip: Apple H2
  • Colour: White
  • Noise Control: None (no ANC, no Transparency mode)
  • Spatial Audio: Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking
  • EQ: Adaptive EQ
  • Microphones: Three microphones, Voice Isolation
  • Battery (AirPods): Up to 5 hours per charge
  • Battery (Total with case): Up to 30 hours
  • Fast Charge: 5 minutes in case provides 1 hour of listening
  • Case Charging: USB-C only (no wireless charging)
  • Case Speaker: No (Find My locates earbuds only, not case)
  • Water Resistance: IP54 (AirPods and case)
  • Connectivity: Bluetooth 5.3
  • Weight per earbud: 4.3g
  • Siri: Hey Siri, Siri Interactions (nod yes, shake no)
  • Compatible: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV

The standard AirPods 4 case charges via USB-C cable only. If wireless charging is important to you, the ANC model is the one to buy. Apple AirPods Pro 3 — White

The Apple AirPods Pro 3 are the most significant upgrade Apple has made to its flagship earbuds in years. AirPods Pro 3 deliver unbelievable sound quality and the world's best in-ear Active Noise Cancellation, removing up to 2x more noise than the previous-generation AirPods Pro 2 and 4x more than the original AirPods Pro. Launched in September 2025, they also introduce the first heart rate sensor ever built into AirPods, Live Translation powered by Apple Intelligence and a completely redesigned acoustic architecture that transforms how music sounds. If you want the absolute best earbuds Apple makes today, this is it.

The World's Best In-Ear Active Noise Cancellation

AirPods Pro 3 deliver the world's best ANC of any in-ear wireless headphones. This is made possible with ultra-low noise microphones and advanced computational audio combined with new foam-infused ear tips for greater passive noise isolation. The combination of hardware and software working together is what makes the ANC on AirPods Pro 3 so effective. The foam-infused ear tips physically block more sound before it reaches your ear canal — passive isolation. The H2 chip and ultra-low noise microphones then apply active cancellation on top of that, electronically removing what the physical seal could not. Two layers of noise removal working simultaneously.

For daily life in Pakistan, this matters enormously. Karachi's traffic is among the loudest urban environments in the world. Open-plan offices in Lahore and Islamabad generate constant background noise. Air conditioning hum, generator noise during power cuts, street vendors and construction sounds are all part of the daily acoustic environment. The AirPods Pro 3's ANC addresses all of this at a level no previous AirPods model could match. With AirPods Pro 3 in, the world around you genuinely quietens.

New Multiport Acoustic Architecture — Completely Transformed Sound

AirPods Pro 3 feature a new multiport acoustic architecture that precisely controls the airflow that carries sound into the ear, helping deliver an exceptional spatial listening experience. With next-generation Adaptive EQ, the new architecture transforms the bass response, widens the soundstage so users hear every instrument, and brings vivid vocal clarity to higher frequencies across music, shows and calls.

The multiport architecture is a fundamental engineering change to how sound reaches your ear, not an incremental adjustment to the previous design. The result is bass that is deeper and more controlled, a wider soundstage that places instruments and voices across a broader space, and higher frequency clarity that makes vocals cut through more precisely. For music genres popular in Pakistan — qawwali, Bollywood, pop, hip-hop and classical — this translates to a noticeably richer and more detailed listening experience than any previous AirPods model delivered.

Heart Rate Monitoring — No Apple Watch Required

AirPods Pro 3 feature a new custom-built heart rate sensor and integrated workout experience. With just AirPods Pro 3 and an iPhone, users can track their heart rate and calories burned during workouts and even close their Move ring and earn awards in the Fitness app. The infrared light pulses 256 times per second to detect blood flow, delivering precise measurements during workouts.

AirPods Pro 3 can track over 50 different workout types, monitor heart rate and calories burned, help users close their Move ring and offer performance awards directly in the Fitness app. For Pakistani fitness enthusiasts who run outdoors, train at the gym or do home workouts, the AirPods Pro 3 removes the need for an Apple Watch to access heart rate data. You run with your AirPods in — which you would do anyway — and your heart rate, calories and workout data are automatically tracked and synced to the Health app on your iPhone.

AI Workout Buddy

With Apple Intelligence, users gain access to Workout Buddy, a first-of-its-kind AI-powered system that uses historical data and real-time metrics to provide motivation during sessions. Workout Buddy analyses your historical fitness data and your real-time heart rate during a session and provides personalised coaching and motivation audio during workouts. It knows how you have trained before and adjusts its guidance to what your body is doing right now.

Live Translation — Real-Time Language in Your Ear

AirPods Pro 3 can facilitate real-time multilingual communication using computational audio and Apple Intelligence. When enabled, they capture speech, translate it and deliver the translated result directly to the user's ear. For Pakistani professionals working in international environments, business travellers or anyone who regularly interacts with people speaking different languages, Live Translation is a genuinely transformative feature. You hear the translation in your ear in real time while the conversation is happening — no phone to hold up, no app to open, no delay in the flow of conversation.

Redesigned Fit — The Most Secure AirPods Ever Made

Apple reengineered the AirPods Pro 3 using more than 10,000 ear scans and over 100,000 hours of user research to make the AirPods Pro 3 the most secure and best-fitting AirPods yet. The internal AirPods architecture was overhauled to make each AirPod smaller, while the geometry of the ear tip was aligned to the center of the body for better stability.

The practical result is AirPods that stay in place during running, HIIT, yoga and any other movement-heavy workout without the constant concern of them shifting or falling out. The new XXS ear tip size means even smaller ears now have a proper fit option — previously an issue for some women and younger users who found the XS tips too large. The foam-infused ear tips come in five sizes: XXS, XS, S, M and L. The foam improves passive noise isolation and makes extended wear more comfortable by conforming slightly to the shape of your ear canal over time.

IP57 Water Resistance — Significantly Better Than Before

AirPods Pro 3 have IP57-rated sweat and water resistance, up from IP54 for the AirPods Pro 2. By definition, an IP57 rating means the AirPods Pro 3 can withstand temporary immersion in up to one meter of water. The upgrade from IP54 to IP57 is meaningful for workout use. IP54 protects against splashing from any direction. IP57 adds resistance to temporary submersion — getting caught in a heavy downpour during an outdoor run, sweating heavily during a gym session or accidentally dropping them in water are all situations the AirPods Pro 3 handles without damage that the Pro 2 was more vulnerable to.

Personalized Transparency — Hear the World Naturally

With a more personalized Transparency mode, a user's own voice and the people speaking to them sounds more natural than ever, helping them stay connected to their surroundings without missing a beat. The personalization means that Transparency mode is tuned to your specific ear shape and hearing characteristics. Voices, ambient sound and your own voice while speaking all pass through more naturally than in previous generations. For Pakistani users who wear their AirPods in meetings, while shopping or in social settings where they need to remain present and aware, personalized Transparency makes the experience of wearing AirPods Pro 3 genuinely seamless with real-world interaction.

Extended Battery Life

AirPods Pro 3 deliver up to 8 hours of listening time on a single charge with Active Noise Cancellation enabled, a 33 percent increase over the previous generation. In Transparency mode, playback lasts up to 10 hours on a single charge, a 67 percent improvement. Total listening time with the charging case is 24 hours with ANC active. 5 minutes in the case provides around 1 hour of listening time. The fast charge capability means a brief top-up while you get ready is enough for a full commute or workout session.

MagSafe Charging Case

The AirPods Pro 3 comes with a MagSafe charging case that supports USB-C, MagSafe and Qi wireless charging, as well as the Apple Watch charger. The case features Apple's second-generation Ultra Wideband chip, allowing the Precision Finding feature to work at 1.5x longer distance in the Find My app. Precision Finding uses directional audio and the Find My app to guide you toward your lost case with increasing precision as you get closer — particularly useful when your case has slipped under furniture or into a bag pocket.

Studio Quality Recording

With iOS 26, AirPods Pro 3 offer studio-quality audio recording for interviews, podcasts, songs, videos and more. The upgraded microphone array combined with H2 processing delivers recording quality that goes well beyond standard iPhone microphone recordings. For Pakistani content creators, podcasters and journalists who want professional audio quality without carrying dedicated recording equipment, AirPods Pro 3 with an iPhone running iOS 26 provides a genuinely capable recording setup.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much better is the ANC on AirPods Pro 3 compared to AirPods Pro 2?

AirPods Pro 3 offer up to 2x more active noise cancellation than AirPods Pro 2 and up to 4x more than the original AirPods Pro, delivering the world's best ANC of any in-ear wireless headphones. This improvement comes from three combined factors: ultra-low noise microphones that capture more precise readings of environmental sound, advanced computational audio from the H2 chip that processes cancellation more accurately and the new foam-infused ear tips that add greater passive isolation before active cancellation even begins.

Can I track heart rate with AirPods Pro 3 without an Apple Watch?

Yes. AirPods Pro 3 feature a custom-built heart rate sensor. With just AirPods Pro 3 and an iPhone, users can track their heart rate and calories burned, close their Move ring and earn awards for 50 different workout types in the Fitness app. The heart rate sensor uses infrared light pulsed 256 times per second to measure blood flow. Heart rate data is accurate within approximately 3 BPM during steady-state cardio activities like running and cycling. No Apple Watch is required for any of this functionality.

What is Live Translation and which languages does it support?

AirPods Pro 3 capture speech using computational audio and Apple Intelligence, translate it and deliver the translated result directly to the user's ear in real time. At launch, Live Translation supports English, French, German, Portuguese and Spanish, with Italian, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese arriving later in 2025 as an update. The feature requires an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone running iOS 26. It works in both one-on-one and group conversations and if both speakers wear AirPods Pro 3, the system manages audio levels and translations automatically for both parties simultaneously.

What is the difference between AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods 4 with ANC?

The AirPods Pro 3 is Apple's flagship earbuds while the AirPods 4 ANC is the mid-tier option. The key differences are: AirPods Pro 3 has significantly stronger ANC with foam-tipped in-ear design versus the open-ear AirPods 4; Pro 3 adds heart rate monitoring, Live Translation, studio-quality recording and Workout Buddy; Pro 3 has IP57 water resistance versus IP54 on AirPods 4; Pro 3 offers 8 hours with ANC versus 4 hours on AirPods 4 ANC; and Pro 3 comes with a MagSafe charging case with Ultra Wideband. If you want the best noise cancellation, workout tracking without an Apple Watch and the full feature set, the Pro 3 is the right choice. If you prefer an open-ear comfortable fit at a lower price, the AirPods 4 ANC is excellent.

Are the foam-infused ear tips significantly different from standard silicone tips?

The new foam tips improve passive noise isolation. The foam infusion means the tips compress slightly and conform to your ear canal shape over time, creating a more complete seal than smooth silicone tips that simply press against the canal. A better passive seal means more sound blocked before ANC needs to do any work, which makes the overall noise isolation better. The foam also makes extended wear more comfortable for many users as the material feels softer against the ear canal than standard smooth silicone.

What is the IP57 water resistance rating?

IP57 means the AirPods Pro 3 can withstand temporary immersion in up to one meter of water. This is up from IP54 on the AirPods Pro 2. In practical terms for Pakistani users this means heavy rain, very sweaty workouts and accidental drops in water are all handled without damage. Apple's marketing specifies they are intended for workouts and unexpected weather, not water sports like swimming. The case is also IP57 rated — not just the earbuds.

What is Precision Finding and does it work in Pakistan?

The MagSafe Charging Case features Apple's second-generation Ultra Wideband chip, allowing Precision Finding to work at 1.5x longer distance in the Find My app. Precision Finding guides you toward your lost case using directional audio and on-screen arrows in the Find My app, using the Ultra Wideband chip to give precise direction and distance rather than just a general location. This requires an iPhone 17, iPhone 17 Pro or iPhone 17 Pro Max for full functionality. It works wherever your iPhone has Bluetooth range to the case.

Do AirPods Pro 3 work with older iPhones?

AirPods Pro 3 work as wireless earbuds with any iPhone running iOS 18 or later, including older models. However, some features require specific hardware or software. Heart rate tracking and Live Translation require an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone running iOS 26. Precision Finding at extended range requires an iPhone 17 series. Core features — ANC, Transparency mode, Spatial Audio, Voice Isolation and Siri Interactions — work with any compatible iPhone running iOS 18 or later.
